summary: Convert visitor/contractor profile to full-employee account and reconcile legacy loaner hardware
description:
Issue summary:
We have a recent conversion where an existing visitor/contractor identity (email: taylor.visitor@vendor-example.com) is becoming a full-time Redwood employee (taylor.patel@redwood.ai). The ask is to: (1) split or remap identity so historical audit and artifact ownership are preserved; (2) reconcile and re-enroll a loaner laptop currently recorded under the contractor pool; (3) ensure no service-account or KMS entitlements are unintentionally retained on the legacy identity; and (4) document any exceptional approvals required for license/asset transfer.

Background and context:
- User was onboarded 2024-11 as a vendor under a visitor identity tied to vendor SSO and a temporary laptop (serial: RWD-7B3C21).
- HR completed offer for full-time start date 2026-02-16 and requested transfer of business-critical artifacts (GDrive folders, internal Notebooks) and continued access to certain infra repos.
- Security has flagged the need to avoid orphaned service-account permissions and ensure KMS/HSM key bindings are migrated or rotated.

Impact:
- Blocking productivity for the new hire: missing licenses (Design and DataStudio), blocked repo access, and delays in code handover from contractor work.
- Compliance risk if audit trails show merged identities or leftover vendor entitlements.

What we need from internal teams (clear asks):
1) IAM: guidance and action on converting visitor identity to employee identity without losing ownership metadata (gDrive, Git commits). If split required, create migration plan to reassign ownership records.
2) SCIM/SSO: confirm whether SCIM provisioning can map new email -> existing UID or if a new UID will be created and what DB-level references must be updated.
3) Asset Management: take physical custody or reissue the loaner laptop. If retained by employee, perform hardware ownership transfer and update asset tag and serial in the CMDB. Verify disk encryption and rekey with our KMS if necessary.
4) Security: audit and revoke any long-lived tokens the vendor identity has to service accounts, run a KMS access check, and prepare rekeying plan where needed.
5) HR/Finance: confirm license cost-transfer approval and whether vendor expenses can be absorbed or require new purchase.

Desired deadline: 2026-02-28 (business-critical ramping for product team).

Notes on constraints and preferences:
- Prefer minimal disruption to historical commit and document ownership — retention of last-modified metadata is desirable.
- If absolute preservation impossible, ensure explicit mapping record and Confluence doc of migrated items.
- All actions should be performed with audit logs captured and stored in the Security S3 bucket.
steps_to_complete: 1) IAM: run 'identity:lookup' for taylor.visitor@vendor-example.com and export associated entitlements and linked resources.
2) SCIM/SSO: coordinate with IdP team to verify if email aliasing is possible for taylor.patel@redwood.ai or if a new UID will be provisioned.
3) Create a migration plan to reassign gDrive and Git ownership where possible. Document files that cannot be transferred and obtain approval.

4) Asset: schedule hardware pickup or handoff. If reissuing, issue new asset tag and record transfer; if reassigning, ensure firmware and OS are wiped and device is re-encrypted under corporate KMS with new key version.
5) Security: run token scan (git-secrets / internal token inventory) for the visitor identity and rotate or revoke long-lived credentials; run a KMS ACL audit for related keys.
6) HR/Finance: confirm licensing approvals or trigger procurement tickets for required software packages.
7) Post-action: create a short post-mortem note in Confluence listing what moved, what was archived, and any policy exceptions approved by Security/HR.
investigation_notes: 2026-02-20 Morgan Reyes: initial lookup shows 3 GitHub commits under the visitor email; GitHub account is currently external and mapped to visitor email. No existing Redwood SSO mapping for that email.

2026-02-21 IdP team (Sana Ibrahim): SCIM currently creates new UID for new corporate email; aliasing the vendor email is not supported without manual UID reconciliation. Recommend UID split and ownership reassignment.

2026-02-22 Asset team (Diego Martinez): CMDB record exists for serial RWD-7B3C21 assigned to contractor pool. Last inventory ping 2026-01-15. Device has corporate disk encryption but tied to vendor key (KMS key id: key-prod-zz7).

2026-02-23 Security (Priya Anand): token scan found one long-lived service token in vault referencing the visitor identity used by a CI job. Recommend immediate rotation and replace job principal with a CI-specific service account.
comments: Jordan Patel (2026-02-20): Filing this to avoid last-minute sprint ramp blockers — Taylor needs repo access and laptop by EOD next Tuesday. HR says employee start is effective 2026-02-16.

Sana Ibrahim - IdP (2026-02-21): Quick note — SCIM won't preserve the existing UID. We can do manual reconciliation but it requires 30m of engineering time and a DB-migration-style change. Need approval from Security for mapping policies.

Diego Martinez - Asset Mgmt (2026-02-22): Asset shows up in the contractor pool. We can either recollect and reprovision (preferred) or transfer ownership after secure wipe + rekey. Shipping timelines may add 3 business days.

Priya Anand - Security (2026-02-23): Found a CI credential bound to the vendor identity. We'll schedule rotation for 2026-02-24 morning if approved. This is high priority to avoid entitlements lingering post-conversion.

Morgan Reyes (2026-02-24): Coordinating a short migration window on 2026-02-26 09:00–10:30 PT to perform ownership reassignment and token rotations. Please add any plugins/repos that must be moved to the ticket now.
blockers: Formal approval required from Security for manual UID reconciliation (policy exception).
Pending HR sign-off on license cost transfer for Design/Analytics tools.
Device physical pickup may be delayed if the contractor is remote — shipping logistics dependent on region.
next_steps: 1) Security to approve UID mapping exception or confirm recommended alternative (create new UID + reassignment plan).
2) HR/Finance to confirm license procurement or transfer by 2026-02-24.
3) Schedule device handoff or reprovision window with Asset Mgmt and end-user on 2026-02-26.
4) Execute token rotations during the scheduled migration window and update CI jobs to use CI service account.
resolution_notes: PENDING: work in progress. Will update when token rotation and asset reconciliation complete. All actions will be logged to the Security audit S3 bucket and linked in Confluence.
